visual.general_description: Four-panel set (A-D) of color clinical photographs: whole-body skin involvement in bed, reddened periocular face with crusts, brownish patchy skin with a gown, and a periocular close-up with lids held open showing a corneal opacity.
visual.detailed_description: Panel A shows a person lying in a hospital bed with dark red to purplish-brown skin and tan sheet-like coverings over the torso and limbs. Panel B is a close-up of reddened, crusted periocular skin with narrow palpebral fissures. Panel C is a close-up of brown-red skin with patchy darker flaking areas next to a patterned gown. Panel D is a close-up of the periocular region with gloved fingers retracting the lids, showing a bluish-white corneal opacity in one eye. Panel letters A, B, C and D are printed at the top left of each photograph; no other text, arrows or scale bars appear.

panels.general_description: Color photograph of a person lying on a hospital bed with extensive skin discoloration and tan sheet-like coverings over the torso and limbs.
panels.detailed_description: A person lies on a hospital bed with side rails; a curtain, a blue chair and bed equipment are in the background and part of a white garment appears at the right edge. The skin of the chest, abdomen, arms and legs is dark red to purplish-brown with scattered brighter red spots. Large glossy tan-yellow sheet-like areas lie over the torso, arms and both legs; they cannot be distinguished as detached epidermis or dressings. One forearm is raised with a closed fist and the other arm rests on the abdomen. The legs are flexed. Tan material also covers the head and face region on the left. No panel text, labels, arrows or scale are visible.

visual.general_description: Black-and-white text flow chart of seven stacked boxes giving a day-numbered clinical timeline from surgery to visual rehabilitation follow-up.
visual.detailed_description: Seven stacked black-outlined rectangular boxes with centered bold titles and bulleted lines in black sans-serif text on a white background Box 1 title: "Day 0 Traumatic Retinal Detachment Surgery"; bullets: "23G vitrectomy + silicone oil" and "Post-op meds: levofloxacin, tobramycin-dexamethasone, oral MPred". Box 2 title: "Day 18 Glaucoma Diagnosis"; bullets: "Secondary Glaucoma (Right Eye)", "Symptoms: pain, redness, ↑ IOP" and "Brinzolamide 1% BID started, steroids stopped". Box 3 title: "Day 24: Onset of SJS/TEN Symptoms"; bullets: "Onset of SJS/TEN Symptoms", "High fever, erythema → bullae, mucosal erosions" and "Nikolsky positive; asymmetric ocular signs". Box 4 title: "Day 25: Hospital Admission"; bullets: "Epidermal detachment >80% BSA", "Labs: leukopenia, ↑ CRP, E. coli & Strep+" and "ALDEN = 5, Naranjo = 7". Box 5 title: "Hospital Days 1–10: Treatment Phase"; bullets: "Multidisciplinary Treatment : IVIG, steroids, antibiotics, antifungals" and "Amniotic membrane transplant (ocular)". Box 6 title: "Hospital Day 28: Skin Recovery"; bullets: "Skin healing with hyperpigmentation" and "Left eye: corneal scarring → PKP; Right eye: NLP". Box 7 title: "Follow-up: Visual Rehabilitation"; bullets: "Visual Rehabilitation; Left eye: BCVA 0.05 post-PKP" and "Importance of early recognition & screening".
